lines.text: Levi's sons were Gershon, Kohath and Merari, and Kohath's son Amram had children named Aaron, Moses and Miriam.
An Azariah served as priest in the temple Solomon built in Jerusalem, and Jehozadak went into captivity under Nebuchadnezzar.
David put men in charge of the music, singing before the palace until Solomon built the LORD's house.
Aaron and his sons presented offerings on the altars to make atonement for Edom.
Aaron's descendants got Hebron in Judah, but Caleb son of Jephunneh received the fields and villages around it.
